outcome_evidence: The oven starts closed in frame 0, left_ego_image. After approaching its handle, the robot remains nearly stationary for a sustained interval around frames 60–100 in image, left_ego_image and wrist_image. It subsequently pulls the door downward; frames 150–166 in image and left_ego_image show the open door and exposed oven interior. No damage or disturbance of unrelated objects is visible.

failure_annotations.explanation: Following the approach, the robot sustains a nearly unchanged position beside the oven handle without visibly opening the door during frames 60–100 in image, left_ego_image and wrist_image. This prolonged pause does not advance the task; its underlying cause is not visible.
failure_annotations.recovery: Resume task-directed handle alignment and acquisition, then pull the door along its hinge trajectory while monitoring clearance; no human intervention is visibly needed.
failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The visible consequence is delay only; the oven and surrounding objects remain intact and undisturbed.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: No environmental change requires resetting, so the robot can continue from its current position without human intervention.
